infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Plant App uses the microphone for voice messages to Rooti.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Plant App uses speech recognition to transcribe what you say to Rooti.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Plant App uses the camera to take photos of your plants for identification and Rooti chats.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Plant App uses your photo library to attach plant photos to Rooti chats and identify plants.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Plant App uses your location to fetch local weather, which helps Rooti give better watering advice.
